query:
UPDATE threads
         SET unread = 0,
             snoozed_until = CASE
                 WHEN snoozed_until != 0 AND snoozed_until <= ? THEN 0
                 ELSE snoozed_until
             END
         WHERE id = ?
           AND (unread = 1 OR (snoozed_until != 0 AND snoozed_until <= ?))
